game.name: Rocket Racing
game.rules:
```
Official Fortnite and Fortnite Community Content Series Rules
```

## **General Rules**

- No mods, cheats, or hacks of any kind (vanilla game only).
- All runs must be done in a solo, private lobby.
- All runs require adequate video proof.

## **Acceptable Proof**

- Videos must have a reasonable quality.
- Videos must be single-segmented, showing the entire run.
- Audio must be audible in a decent standard 
- Try to keep the video clean of other overlays. If you are covering an important part of the video needed for verification, your run may be rejected.
- Twitch VODs are not allowed. Please highlight the run.
- If your video includes multiple attempts, please timestamp the actual run.
- If the in-game time is quicker than the last frame the player crosses the finish line at; the run has the right to be rejected by moderators.

## **Use of Glitches**

- Fortnite Series: Due to the rapid pace of bug fixes and lack of downpatching, the use of any major glitches is banned (except in designated categories).
- Fortnite Community Content Series: The use of glitches is up to moderator discretion. Maps can be downpatched using specific version numbers.

> The Moderators of this board reserve the right to modify these boards and rules at any time, without warning. If you feel any Moderators of any speedrun boards in the Fortnite or Fortnite Community Content Series is being unfair, showing favoritism, and/or not verifying runs in a timely manner; please message the Series Moderators."

challengeList.name: SRC Series: Rocket Racing Expert Tracks
challengeList.announcement:
Alright, the prize-eligible runs have been verified and the Expert Tracks challenge is now complete! Thank you all for participating, it was fun as always! You can view the challenge winners in the widget below :)

To the prize winners, you will be receiving emails regarding prize distribution soon. Emails will be sent to your email address associated with your Speedrun.com account, if this is an issue please DM me so we can sort out the proper email!
challengeList.rules:
Please be sure to also read Game Rules and Contest Rules.

## Expert Tracks:

Play through all Expert Tracks in any order, see Track List below

## Additional Rules:

- Timing is done exclusively through the in-game timer, **by adding together all of your track times**. For additional (optional) information on timing, please check out this guide on [how to set up Manual Game Time for Full Game Runs](https://www.speedrun.com/Rocket_Racing/guides/3nky6)
- The use of Ultra Shortcuts or The Speed Glitch are not allowed.
- If you get the no-timer at the end-of-race bug, you can repeat the track that the bug occurred on.
- If the game crashes between tracks, you may reboot your game and continue the run as normal. If the game crashed in the middle of a track, you must unfortunately reset your run. We will re-evalutate this rule if it becomes a major issue, but it hasn't been one in the past.
- You may not use any kind of Trainer, Cheat Table, or any sort of Macro/Turbo during runs. A Macro could include automated actions assigned to a single binding, or multiple actions bound to a single binding.
- LiveSplit is not required for this challenge, but is still encouraged. You may download LiveSplit at [http://livesplit.org/downloads/](http://livesplit.org/downloads/).
- Game cannot be modified in any way, including by third party software, with the exception of patches provided by the developer.
- Game audio must be audible in your submission, however you may disable dialog audio and/or music, just make sure the sound effects are audible in your video submission.
- Modification of the game files is not allowed. This applies to any form of modification, such as texture swaps, model swaps, QoL changes, etc...
- Moderators have the right to hold, or even reject, any run they deem contrary to the spirit of the rules, even if the grounds for such a rejection are not explicitly listed in these rules. For example, if a runner submits a run that contains a powerful, perhaps ‘boundary-pushing’, trick that has not been shown to the wider community.

## Track List

You have to complete all 10 of the following tracks, but they may be completed in any order.

- Anaconda
- Tilted Turnpike
- Olympus
- Riviera
- Curvy Canyon 2
- Airborne 2
- Anarchy Arches 2
- Dust Up 2
- Puddle Jumper 2
- Cliff Runner 2
challengeList.contestRules:
- $250 shall be awarded to the runner with the fastest verified run time, $150 to the runner in 2nd place, and $100 to the runner in 3rd place.
- All awards shall be in cash payable by bank transfer.
- Run shall be verified to be in compliance with run rules (see below) and judged by Speedrun.com moderators and staff
- Run must be performed between challenge start and end dates
- Run must remain submitted throughout verification process; if run is deleted before verification and payout are complete, run/user is disqualified
- Runs that are eligible for prize winnings must be live streamed, with a VOD attached somewhere in the submission form.
- Void where prohibited
- Not open to citizens of North Korea, Syria, Sudan, Cuba, and Venezuela
- Winners may be required to submit identify verification in order to claim prize
- Personal information gathered will only be used to contact winners and/or notify participants of associated prizes.  Speedrun.com’s full privacy policy can be found here: [https://www.speedrun.com/pages/privacy-policy](https://www.speedrun.com/pages/privacy-policy)
- Runs must be submitted **[here](https://www.speedrun.com/challenges/og37qyvl-Rocket_Racing-src-series-rocket-racing)**.  Note that this is NOT the regular Rocket Racing game page and leaderboard, this is a challenge board. Runs submitted to the regular leaderboard are not counted as entries for the Speedrun Challenge.  
- Entries must be submitted by **11:59 PM UTC February 25, 2024.**
- No purchase necessary
- Please post questions around contest and run rules in the Rocket Racing Speedrun Challenge forum post, found here: [https://www.speedrun.com/forums/tournaments_and_races/gr3cb](https://www.speedrun.com/forums/tournaments_and_races/gr3cb)
